notes: The gateway's own HMAC tests sign with Utc::now() and assert accept/reject only; they contain NO fixed expected signatures. Every signature_base64 below is auditor-computed (python3 hmac/hashlib/base64, cross-checked for the first vector with `openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac`).
Signing string = '\n'.join([profile, namespace, username, authority, METHOD, raw_path, raw_query, Date, digest_header_value, nonce]) (src/plugins/hmac_auth.rs:1902-1943). No trailing newline.

These vectors will NOT verify against a live gateway unless the gateway clock is within clock_skew_seconds (default/max 300) of the vector Date; re-sign with a fresh Date and nonce for live tests. They are for unit-testing Anvil's canonicalization and HMAC code.
Each v2 nonce is single-use per (namespace, plugin-config id, consumer id) for 601 s (src/plugins/hmac_auth.rs:138,1215).
